newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD details ready next week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD details ready next week.

text.p: Brazil will complete next week tender details for the sale of mining conglomerate Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), a spokeswoman for the BNDES development bank said.
The spokeswoman said the tender document would have to approved by the National Privatization Council (CND) before being published.
The CND agreed September 5 to start the privatization process of CVRD in February 1997 with a block sale of 40-45 percent of voting shares.
Immediately after the block sale, 10 percent of CVRD's total capital will be offered to staff, followed by a public offering on international and domestic markets from June 1997 on.
The government owns 76 percent of CVRD's voting capital, equivalent to 51 percent of the company's total capital.

Tender documents for the 40-45 percent block, a kind of holding dubbed Valecom, had been expected to be published by the end of September. The minimum price of shares is to be decided 60 days before the block sale.
